relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from front matter: the document self-identifies as arXiv:1202.6268v2 and its title and author pair match the registered entry. CITATION STATE: a true bib orphan — zero sites in content/ and zero in computations/. RELEVANCE IS REAL AND UNUSED, and unusually close to live QOU work: it takes a Neumann-Zagier datum (shapes together with the gluing equations in canonical form) and defines a formal power series whose first subleading term is the non-abelian Reidemeister-Ray-Singer torsion, then proves topological invariance of that 1-loop part and checks it numerically against the torsion for all 59924 hyperbolic knots with at most 14 crossings. QOU has lean/QOU/OneLoopEdgeLattice.lean plus a family of NZ-datum Lean files (NZBarEvenVolumeFace, ObservableComplexVolumeVsFullPotential, CuspShapeBarParity) that all cite neumann-zagier1985 for the classical datum but have no source for the quantum/1-loop refinement they work around. Held at supporting rather than core because I found no QOU claim that presently requires the 1-loop invariance theorem — only claims that would be better sourced by it.

keyResults.locator: Abstract / topological invariance of the 1-loop part
keyResults.statement: The 1-loop term of the series built from a Neumann-Zagier datum is independent of the ideal triangulation and equals the non-abelian Reidemeister-Ray-Singer torsion; verified numerically for all 59924 hyperbolic knots with at most 14 crossings.
keyResults.useForFolio: Sources the 1-loop/torsion layer that the one-loop edge-lattice and NZ-datum Lean files reach for without a citation beyond the classical NZ result.

proposedActions.rationale: A registered reference with zero citation sites that directly supplies the 1-loop-from-NZ-datum construction the one-loop edge-lattice file is built around.
